text: Hi Italy! Austria here. Proposing peace: no units in VEN/TRI/TYR from either side. I'm heading east (Balkans); you're free to go west/Tunis. Happy to coordinate against Turkey later via Ionian. Deal?
Hi Russia, Austria here. I'd like a solid partnership. Proposal: Galicia stays empty (DMZ), you take RUM, I take SER/GRE, and we work together on Turkey. Can you confirm you won't move into GAL?
Hi Germany, Austria here. Let's keep BOH/TYR demilitarized and stay friends - I have no interest in Munich. Shared interest in keeping Russia in check if he gets aggressive. Deal?
Hi Turkey, Austria here. Hoping for a peaceful start. I plan SER/GRE; Bulgaria is yours. What are your plans toward Russia and the Black Sea?

Hi France, England here. Here's what I'd like: we keep the Channel empty. I won't put a fleet in ENG if you don't. That frees both of us to expand elsewhere, me to Scandinavia and you to Iberia and maybe Belgium later. Are you in? I'm also open to coordinating against Germany if that interests you.

Hi Germany, England here. I'm hoping we can be friendly neighbours. I'm aiming for Norway and won't touch Denmark or Holland if you stay out of the North Sea. What are your plans? I'd be glad to keep France in check together.

Hi Russia, England here. I'm planning on Norway this year. If you take Sweden and keep STP's fleet out of Norway and Barents, we won't be stepping on each other. Can we agree? Happy to work together against Germany later.
Hi England, France here. I'd like peace between us. Proposal: Channel stays empty (I won't enter ENG if you don't), you take NWY/North, I go Iberia. Let's both keep an eye on Germany. Deal?

Hi Germany, France here. I'd like a quiet border: Burgundy stays a DMZ, you take HOL/DEN, I take Iberia and won't contest BEL early without talking to you. Happy to coordinate against England if they get aggressive. Thoughts?
Hi Italy, France here. Let's keep Piedmont and Gulf of Lyon demilitarized so we can both focus elsewhere — you on Austria/Turkey/Tunis, me on Iberia and the north. Agreed?

Hi England, Germany here. I'd like us to work together. I'm planning F KIE-DEN and an army to HOL. You take NWY. Can we agree to keep HEL clear of your fleets and leave the North Sea to you? France is the natural target for both of us later. What do you have in mind?
Hi France, Germany here. Shall we keep Burgundy demilitarized? I have no plans in the west beyond Holland. You've got Iberia to take. I'm happy to stay friendly and leave Belgium to talks later.
Hi Russia, Germany here. Let's keep Prussia and Silesia empty so neither of us has to worry about the other. Sweden is yours if you want it; I only want Denmark. Can we agree on that?
Germany here. I'm not interested in Tyrolia or Bohemia. Shall we leave them empty? My attention is north and west.

Hi Austria! Italy here. I'd like a firm peace with you: no units in TYR/TRI/VEN on either side, and I'm thinking of working with you against Turkey (Lepanto-style: I go to Ionian/Tunis, then help you in the east). What are your opening plans?
Hi France, Italy here. Proposal: keep PIE and LYO demilitarized, I take Tunis, you take Iberia. Happy to coordinate if Germany or England get pushy. Sound good?
Hi Germany, Italy here. No interest in Tyrolia or Munich from me — I'm looking south and east. Let's keep TYR empty and stay in touch about France.
Hi Turkey, Italy here. I'm opening toward Tunis and the west. Hope we can stay friendly; let me know your plans.

Hi Turkey. Russia here. Proposal: Black Sea stays demilitarized (I won't enter BLA if you don't), I take Rumania, you take Bulgaria. Neither of us gains from bouncing in BLA all year. Open to working together against Austria later if it suits us both.

Hi Austria. Russia here. I'd like peace: Galicia DMZ (I won't enter if you don't). I'm aiming at Rumania and the north; you have Serbia/Greece. Happy to coordinate against Turkey or Italy if that helps you.
Hi Germany. Russia here. Offer: I won't move into Prussia or Silesia, you keep out of them too. I'm going for Sweden, you have Denmark/Holland. Let's keep our border quiet and both grow.
Hi England. Russia here. Norway is yours as far as I'm concerned; I'm after Sweden only. Leave STP alone and I'll keep my fleets out of the Barents/Norwegian seas. Deal?

Hi Russia! Turkey here. Proposal: Black Sea DMZ — I won't enter BLA if you don't, so neither of us wastes a fleet. I take BUL, you're welcome to RUM. I'd love to coordinate against Austria and keep you free to deal with the north. Interested?
Hi Austria, Turkey here. I'm looking for a peaceful south: I take BUL only, no moves toward GRE or SER. Happy to share info on Russia and Italy. Let's keep each other safe in 1901.
Hi Italy, Turkey here. I've no designs westward — my fleets stay east. If you're thinking about Austria, let's talk; a quiet Ionian/Aegean border suits me.
Agreed: TYR/TRI/VEN DMZ. I like the Lepanto idea. You go ION/Tunis; I'll take SER and GRE. Let's talk again in the fall about hitting Turkey together.
Confirmed: GAL DMZ, you take RUM, I take SER/GRE. Let's keep each other posted on what Turkey does in the Black Sea.
Agreed, BOH and TYR stay empty. Good luck in the north/west, and let's keep in touch.
Sounds good. BUL is yours, SER/GRE are mine, and neither of us crosses that line in 1901. Let's share what we hear about Russia.
Deal. ENG stays empty from both sides. I go NWY and north, you take Iberia. Let's keep talking each phase and watch Germany together.
Agreed. You take DEN and HOL, I take NWY and the North Sea, and I'll keep my fleets out of HEL. Let's stay in touch about France as things develop.
Deal. NWY is mine, SWE is yours, and I stay away from STP. You keep out of BAR and NWG. Good luck down south.

Agreed: ENG stays empty, you go Scandinavia, I go Iberia. I'm open to working together on Germany later, so let's see how 1901 goes and talk in the fall. Please tell me if Germany or Russia proposes anything against me, and I'll do the same for you.
Agreed: BUR is a DMZ and you take HOL. I'll keep in touch about BEL. Please let me know if England pitches anything against me. I'm happy to share info either way.
Agreed: PIE and LYO are demilitarized, Tunis is yours and Iberia is mine. Let's keep each other informed about Germany and Austria.
Agreed. I'll stay out of the North Sea, and you leave DEN, HOL and HEL to me. NWY is yours. Let's stay in touch about France as things develop.
Agreed: Burgundy stays a DMZ, I take HOL/DEN, you take Iberia, and we talk before anyone moves on BEL. Let's keep each other posted if England turns aggressive.
Deal. PRU and SIL stay empty, Sweden is yours, Denmark and Holland are mine. Quiet border.
Deal. BOH and TYR stay demilitarized. Happy to coordinate if Russia gets aggressive.
Deal. TYR stays empty. Let's keep talking about France.

Deal: VEN/TRI/TYR stay empty on both sides. I'll go Ionian/Tunis this year. If Turkey looks aggressive toward you, tell me and I'll bring my fleet east to help. Let's keep each other posted every turn.
Agreed: PIE and LYO stay empty. Good luck in Iberia. Let's keep talking, especially if England or Germany turn on you.
Agreed, TYR stays empty from my side. Good luck up north.
Sounds good. A quiet Ionian/Aegean line works for me this year. I'm focused on Tunis. Let's keep in touch.
Confirmed: I won't enter GAL this spring if you don't. RUM for me, SER/GRE for you. Let's stay in touch about Turkey as things develop.
Agreed: BLA DMZ, BUL yours, RUM mine. Let's keep talking about Austria. I'll keep my word on the Black Sea.
Agreed: PRU and SIL stay empty, Sweden mine, Denmark yours. Good luck in the west.
Agreed: Norway yours, Sweden mine, my STP fleet stays out of NWY/BAR. Happy to talk about Germany later.
Agreed: BLA stays empty, you take RUM, I take BUL. Let's keep in touch every phase. If Austria pushes into GAL or RUM, I'll back you. Good luck up north.
Sounds good. Bulgaria for me, SER/GRE for you. Russia and I have agreed to keep the Black Sea empty, so I'm not looking for a fight there. Let's keep each other updated.
Great, Tunis and the west make sense for you. I'll stay in the east. Let's keep the Ionian quiet and share anything we hear.
Great. I'll message you after every phase. If you see a Turkish fleet heading for the Aegean or Ionian, tell me and I'll do the same.
Good to hear. Just so you know, Turkey told me you two agreed to keep the Black Sea empty. Is that right on your side?
Hi Italy, England here. We're far apart, so I see no conflict between us. If France turns aggressive, a quiet word between us could help us both. Good luck this year.
Hi Turkey, England here. We're at opposite corners, so I'm happy to share information whenever it's useful. Let me know if anything comes up.
Hi Austria, England here. We have no conflicts, and I'm glad to keep in touch about Germany and Russia as the game develops.
Hi Russia, France here. I'm heading for Iberia and have no designs on you. If Germany or England ever gets too strong, I'd be happy to coordinate with you. Let's keep each other informed.
Hi, France here. I'm sending a friendly hello. I'm focused on Iberia and the west, and I'm open to talking about anything at any time.
Will do. England has only offered a quiet North Sea border so far. Nothing aimed at you. If that changes, I'll let you know.
Good. One more thing: if you happen to see French fleets heading for the Channel, tell me and I'll do the same for you.
Great. My plan: F NAP-ION, A ROM-APU, A VEN holds. Fall: ION-TUN or convoy. Any read on Russia? If Russia and Turkey team up against you, I'll come east sooner.
Thanks. If you hear anything about France or Austria moving my way, I'd appreciate a heads-up. I'll do the same for you.
Good. One more thing: let's also keep Armenia empty so Sevastopol and Ankara both feel safe. Thanks for the offer of support against Austria. I'll do the same for you.
Confirmed on my side. Let me know if Austria opens toward Galicia. I'll pass on anything I hear from Vienna.
Hello from Turkey. I'm far from you all, but I'm happy to share news from the east and keep in touch. Good luck in 1901.

Sounds good. Russia agreed to a GAL DMZ and says he's going for RUM; I'll watch to see if he keeps it. Turkey says he only wants BUL. I'm going for SER this spring and GRE in the fall. Let's compare notes after the moves.
Hi England, likewise. We have no conflicts, so let's share what we see of Germany and Russia.
Hello France, thanks. I'm busy in the Balkans and we have no conflicts. Let's stay in touch.
Will do. If I see any French moves toward the Channel or Belgium, I'll let you know right away. Please do the same if you spot anything aimed at me.
Thanks Turkey, likewise. I'd be glad to hear news from the east any time.
Thanks, Turkey. Same from me. I'm glad to swap news from the west for news from the east. Good luck.
Thanks, that's good to hear. I'll pass along anything that concerns you. Good luck this year.
Hello Turkey, Germany here. Glad to swap news from the east and west. Good luck in 1901.
Will do. Nothing heard about moves against you so far. I'll pass on anything I hear.
Hi England, agreed, no conflict between us. Happy to swap info on France. Good luck!
Yes, that's correct. Turkey and I agreed BLA stays empty and BUL goes to Turkey. I'll tell you if anything changes. Our GAL DMZ stands.
Thanks France. No designs on you either. Let's keep each other informed, especially about England and Germany.
Agreed, Armenia stays empty too. BLA and ARM are both DMZ. Glad we're on the same page.
Thanks, same here. I'll pass along anything useful from the east.
Thanks for confirming. Our GAL DMZ stands on my side too. Good luck in RUM, and let's talk after the moves.
All set on my side. ENG stays empty. Good luck in Iberia, and let's talk again in the fall.
Sounds good, Russia. Let's keep talking.
Likewise, Austria. Good luck in the Balkans.
Sounds good. Good luck this year, and let's talk again after the Spring moves.
Sounds good. Talk after the moves. Good luck in SER!
Great, BLA and ARM both DMZ. Let's talk again after the moves.
Thanks Germany, glad to hear it. I'll pass along news from the east. Good luck.
Confirmed: BUL for me, SER/GRE for you, no crossing in 1901. I'll tell you if I hear anything from St Petersburg or Moscow.

Spring went as agreed, thanks! This fall: I'm taking GRE with ALB, supported by SER. Please keep ION out of Greece. Are you heading for Tunis? Next year we can plan Turkey together. Did you see Turkey put F CON and A BUL forward?

Nice work getting RUM. I'm taking GRE this fall and the GAL DMZ still stands. What's your plan for A UKR? Turkey sitting in BUL with F CON behind it looks pushy toward you. Shall we keep an eye on it together?
Thanks for keeping your word. I'm moving into GRE this fall as agreed, and BUL is yours. Let's keep it peaceful.

Spring went as agreed, thanks. France's A PIC looks set for Belgium. I'd rather Belgium went to one of us than to France. Proposal: your A KIE-HOL, A RUH S F NTH-BEL. That gives you HOL and DEN, I get NWY and BEL, and France stays at 2 builds. Interested?
Spring was clean on both sides, thanks. I'm taking NWY this fall. What's A PIC planning? Germany has RUH sitting next to BEL and HOL, so be careful there.
All good on my side. NWY this fall, and SWE is yours as agreed. How are things with Turkey and Austria?

Hi Germany. As promised, I'm talking to you before BEL. You'll get DEN and HOL this fall, and I'd like BEL as my third. That leaves us level, with England squeezed at 4 and nothing on our shared border. Can you keep RUH out of BEL and send KIE or RUH to HOL? If you're good with it, I'll keep BUR empty and back you against England in 1902.
Hi England. ENG stayed empty on both sides, thanks. Enjoy NWY. I plan to move PIC to BEL this fall. Please don't support Germany into it. Next year I'm open to working with you against Germany.

Spring went as agreed, thanks. France's A PIC is now sitting on Belgium. I'm moving A RUH to BEL this Fall. Would you support it with F NTH, so France can't take BEL with PIC? It would keep France out of the Low Countries and close to both of us. You get NWY as planned. What will F NTH do?
Your A PIC worries me a bit since it sits right next to BEL. Could you take PIC to BRE or BUR-free routes and leave BEL alone this year? I'm only taking HOL and DEN. What are your Fall plans?
Border's quiet as agreed. Sweden is yours, and my F DEN is staying put. Good luck.

Spring went as planned on my side. Fall: I'm convoying A APU to TUN via ION. A VEN holds, so TRI is safe from me. Are you taking GRE with F ALB, supported by SER? Watch Turkey's A BUL, it could contest GRE. Is Russia in RUM behaving?
All quiet from me as promised: I'm taking Tunis this fall. How are things with Russia? His fleet in RUM next to your BUL looks a bit pushy.
All good on my side: PIE/LYO empty, I'm off to Tunis. How are England and Germany treating you? English fleets in NTH/NWG and a German army in RUH.
Spring went as agreed, thanks. I'm keeping RUM and taking SWE this fall. Please keep BUD and SER out of RUM, and GAL stays empty. How is Turkey behaving toward you?
Nice work, both DMZs held. I'm staying in RUM and keeping out of BLA/ARM. Please keep A BUL out of RUM. What are your plans for Austria's Serbia/Greece?
Border quiet as promised. I'm taking SWE with BOT this fall. Please don't contest it from DEN, and I'll keep out of the Baltic coast.
All good on my side. SWE for me, NWY for you as agreed.

Good spring, and thanks for keeping BLA and ARM clear. I'm doing the same. Bulgaria is mine and I'll hold it; Rumania is yours. Austria is in SER and ALB, so he's set for GRE and maybe more. Do you want to squeeze him next year? Your A UKR into GAL plus my pressure on SER would hurt him. What's your plan this fall?
Spring went as agreed. I'm holding BUL and not touching GRE or SER. I see Russia in RUM and UKR, so keep an eye on GAL. Are you taking GRE with ALB this fall?
F ION is in place. Off to Tunis this fall? I'll keep my fleet home in the east, as promised.

Yes: ALB to GRE with SER supporting. Good luck in Tunis. Russia is behaving so far (RUM, SWE next). Turkey says he's holding BUL. Next spring let's talk about a joint move on Turkey: your fleet to AEG/EAS, my armies through BUL.
Agreed: I stay out of RUM and GAL stays empty. Good luck in SWE. Turkey is calm toward me so far. If A UKR stays out of GAL, we're solid.
Yes, ALB to GRE this fall. Thanks for holding BUL. I'm watching Russia's UKR as well.
Understood. I won't support Germany into BEL. F NTH has other jobs this fall. I'm open to working against Germany in 1902. Let's plan it over the winter.
Sorry, I can't this turn. F NTH is needed to get my army to NWY, and I want that settled. I'm staying neutral on BEL this year. You'll still have DEN and HOL. Let's keep talking.

Understood. BEL isn't a hill I'll die on. I'm mostly after SPA and POR this fall. What is RUH doing? If it goes to HOL or BUR, I'd read that as a threat. If RUH heads for HOL and KIE stays home, I'll be happy to settle BEL by talking next year. Let's not bounce each other and give England a free hand.

PIC is aiming for BEL. Germany has RUH and KIE right next to HOL and BEL, and it's greedy. If you have a fleet to spare, F NTH S A PIC - BEL would block Germany from taking three neutrals and becoming the North's bully. In return I'll back you against Germany in 1902 and stay out of ENG.
Fine so far. Both have kept their word, but Germany's RUH is eyeing BEL, so I'm watching it. Good luck in Tunis. Keep an eye on Austria's F ALB too.

I like the idea of keeping France out of BEL. Counter-offer: F NTH S A RUH-BEL and A KIE-HOL. That keeps your fleet free and stops my army being a sitting target. In 1902 I'll back you into ENG or BRE and won't build fleets aimed at you. France is heading for 5 with Iberia, so we need to hit them together early. Can you do that?
Thanks for asking first. I'm still talking with England about the North Sea. I'll get back to you before orders.
Agreed, I won't contest SWE. F DEN won't go there.

Yes, I'm convoying APU to Tunis, and ION stays out of Greece. Good luck there. Yes, I noticed F CON and A BUL. If Turkey supports BUL into GRE you may bounce, so keep SER's support solid. Let's plan Turkey together over the winter.
Yes, off to Tunis. Thanks for keeping things quiet in the east.
A UKR is just backing up RUM this fall, nothing aimed at you. GAL DMZ stands. Agreed, Turkey in BUL with F CON behind it bears watching. Let's swap what we hear. Good luck in GRE.
This fall I'm holding RUM and taking SWE, nothing else. Squeezing Austria next year is worth discussing. Let's see where his units end up after fall and plan in winter. BLA/ARM DMZ stands.
Quiet in the south so far. Everyone is keeping their deals. I'll keep you posted. Good luck in NWY.
Thanks, appreciated. Same from me.

A BUL stays in BUL; it isn't moving to RUM. On Austria: he's taking GRE this fall, which leaves him with 5 and spread thin. I'd like to hit him in 1902. You go GAL, I press SER from BUL, and Italy might go for TRI. Will you commit to that? If so, we keep BLA/ARM as DMZ for good.
Russia has been fine with me so far and we have a Black Sea deal. Austria looks like the one growing fast with SER and GRE. If you ever fancy Trieste, let me know.
Good, all as agreed. Enjoy Greece.
Thanks. SER's support for GRE is solid. Over the winter let's plan Turkey: your fleets in ION/AEG and my armies pushing on BUL. Good luck in Tunis.
Thanks, all clear. Let's keep swapping intel on Turkey. Good luck in SWE.

I hear you, but I'm staying neutral on BEL this fall. NTH is convoying my army to NWY. I'm not supporting France into BEL either. You'll have DEN and HOL. I like the idea of working together in 1902, so let's talk it through over the winter.
I'm staying neutral on BEL. NTH is busy convoying to NWY, and I won't support Germany either. Let's plan 1902 against Germany over the winter. Keep ENG empty and I'll do the same.

Thanks. Here's a simple split to keep us both safe: RUH takes HOL, KIE stays home or goes to HOL with support, and I take BEL. That gets you DEN, HOL and SWE later, and me SPA, POR and BEL. Neither of us goes near BUR. If RUH heads for BEL, we just bounce and England wins. Can you confirm?
Thanks, appreciated. Let's plan over the winter. Germany is stalling with me about BEL, so tell me if they say anything about it to you.

To be clear: RUH will not go to BUR, and nothing of mine is moving toward you. KIE goes to HOL and DEN holds. On BEL, my preference is that nobody takes it this year. If PIC stays out, I'll stay out too, and we can settle it by talking in 1902. Agreed?
Understood, NWY comes first. Let's coordinate on France in 1902. Could you let me know where your builds are going?
Interesting, thanks. I'm committed to Tunis this year and won't move on anyone yet. Austria growing to 5 is worth watching, though. Let's keep talking over the winter and see how the board looks.

Sounds good. A spring plan against Turkey works for me: AEG/EAS by sea, you through BUL. Heads-up: Turkey is fishing for me to hit you. I said no. I'd be wary of Russia and Turkey's Black Sea deal too.
Thanks, I'll keep an eye on ALB. Good luck holding BEL off. Let's stay in touch.

In principle, yes. An Austria squeeze in 1902 looks good to me: I go GAL, you press SER, and Italy on TRI would be ideal. Have you talked to Italy? Let's settle the details in winter once we see the builds. BLA/ARM DMZ stays permanent on my side.
We're solid. UKR stays out of GAL this fall. Let me know if Turkey or Italy say anything about you. I'll do the same.
Sounds good. Let's plan in winter once we see where things stand. I'm holding BUL and building at home. BLA/ARM DMZ stands on my side too.
Good luck with Tunis. Let's talk in winter about how the Balkans are shaping up.
Thanks for the heads-up and for turning Turkey down. I'll remember it. Let's lock in the Turkey plan over the winter. If you hear anything more from Constantinople, please pass it on.
Will do. What I'm hearing is that Turkey is quietly looking for partners against his neighbours. I'd be careful about trusting the Black Sea deal for long. Let's keep talking every phase.
Probably one build, most likely a fleet in LON or EDI to cover the coast. I'll confirm in winter. Let's draw up the 1902 plan then.
Germany asked me to support RUH-BEL and I turned them down. I expect RUH to go for BEL regardless. I'm staying neutral, so plan for that.

Agreed. Nobody takes BEL this year. PIC won't enter BEL and RUH won't either. KIE goes to HOL, DEN holds, and BUR stays empty on both sides. We'll settle BEL by talking in 1902. Thanks for being straight with me.
Thanks. ENG stays empty from me. Let's talk properly over the winter about 1902.

I'll be straight with you. KIE goes to HOL, DEN holds, and nothing goes near BUR. I can't agree to you taking BEL this year, because 6 French centers in 1901 would worry me a lot. My offer is that BEL stays neutral. If PIC moves in, we'll probably bounce. Let's settle it properly in 1902. I'd honestly rather have you as a partner against England.
Fair enough. Let's talk over the winter. I'd like us to agree a plan against France for 1902.
Agreed. Let's plan it in winter. I'll probably build a fleet in NAP so I can push into AEG/EAS in spring.

Hi Italy, Russia here. We haven't talked yet. I have no designs on you. Austria is getting big in the Balkans (SER, ALB, and GRE coming). If you're thinking about Trieste in 1902, I may be able to put pressure on Galicia/Budapest. Interested?
Good. Talk in winter.

Great. I've only sounded Italy out so far. He seemed interested in Austria's growth but is busy with Tunis this year. I'll push him over the winter. We'll settle the details then. DMZ is permanent on my side too.
Agreed, we'll talk in winter. If Austria takes GRE he'll have 5 and be spread thin between us. Worth thinking about Trieste for 1902.
A fleet in NAP sounds good. I'll probably build an army to push on BUL. Let's talk in winter.
Agreed. Let's work out the details in winter. Good luck this fall.
Likewise. Let's talk in winter.

Understood. My position stays the same: BEL is neutral this year and we settle it by talking in 1902. I'm holding you to RUH staying out of BEL. If a German unit ends up in BEL this fall, I'll treat it as a broken deal. If we both keep our word, I'm glad to partner with you in 1902.
Thanks for the heads-up, it really helps, and I'll remember it. ENG stays empty from my side. Let's work out a 1902 plan against Germany over the winter.
Confirmed. Neither of us enters BEL, BUR stays empty, KIE goes to HOL and DEN holds. Talk in winter.

Hi Russia, good to hear from you. I have no designs on you either. I'm focused on Tunis this fall, but I'm watching Austria's growth too. Let's keep talking over the winter and compare notes on the Balkans.
Noted. Let's see how the fall shakes out and talk properly in winter.
Thanks for the heads-up. I'll stay alert on Turkey. Talk in winter.
Thanks for pushing Italy. Let's plan in winter.
Talk in winter. Good luck in Sweden.

Got GRE, thanks for keeping ION out of it. I'm building armies in BUD and VIE. Spring idea: you send F ION to AEG and I hit BUL from SER and GRE, with F GRE supporting. Is your new fleet in NAP? We should time it so Turkey can't hold BUL.
Good year for both of us. I'm building armies to deal with Turkey. GAL DMZ still stands. If you move on Turkey via BLA/ARM in spring while I hit BUL, he folds quickly. Interested?

Winter as promised. I'm building F LON. My idea for 1902: you and I squeeze France. BEL is the open centre, and I'd like it. If you support F NTH-BEL in spring, I'll move F LON-ENG to pressure BRE/PIC and back your army into BUR. What do you have in mind, and what are you building?

Winter as promised. Germany took DEN and HOL and wants me to help against you. I haven't said yes. What would you offer for 1902? I'm interested in BEL. If you'd back me there and point PIC at RUH/BUR against Germany, we could work together. What are you building?
Good year for both of us. Keeping to it: NWY mine, SWE yours, no fleets into BAR/NWG from you, and I stay away from STP. Germany is strong with 5. Any interest in pressuring them together later?

Thanks for keeping your word on BEL. Trust earned. I'd like a real partnership for 1902. Proposal: BEL goes to me (you got HOL+DEN), and in exchange we work together against England. My fleets push into the Channel/Irish side, you take NTH/Scandinavia. BUR stays empty. Russia is at 6 and growing too. What do you think?
Thanks for the honesty this fall. Germany ended up staying out of BEL. What are your 1902 plans? I'm still keeping ENG empty. Tell me what you need from me and what Germany is saying to you.
Congrats on Tunis. The west is calm for now. Our PIE/LYO deal stands on my side. How's it looking with Austria? It's already at 5.

Thanks for keeping your word on BEL. I kept mine too. I'd like to make this a real partnership. England's fleets sit in NTH and NWG and threaten us both. Proposal for 1902: we work together against England, I keep BUR empty, and we agree on BEL. What are you building?
Congrats on NWY. What are you building and where? I'd like to know before I set my own builds. Do you still see France as our shared problem in 1902?
Thanks for keeping the border quiet. I'm happy to keep PRU and SIL empty. You're on 6 now, so I hope your builds face south and north rather than toward me. What are your plans?

Congrats on 5! I'm building F NAP for the Turkey push. Small question: A BUD to TRI puts an army on the VEN border. I assume it's defensive, but can you confirm TRI won't move to VEN/TYR? For spring I'm thinking F ION to AEG and F NAP to ION. Your plan for BUL?
Thanks Russia. Austria at 5 with an army in TRI next to my VEN is worth watching. I'm keeping my options open. What are your plans for spring? Do you have units to spare for GAL?
Winter thoughts: Austria at 5 with A TRI on my border. I'm not committing yet, but tell me what you'd do in spring if I looked at Trieste. Would A BUL go for SER, or would you move on GRE?

Good year for both of us. On Austria in 1902: he has only 3 units and A TRI looks pointed at Italy, so BUD/VIE are thin. I can hit GAL then BUD in spring. Can you hit SER from BUL in spring, or support Italy? What are you building? I'm planning armies. BLA/ARM DMZ stays permanent.

Congrats on Tunis. Austria moved A BUD to TRI, right on your border with VEN. Is he friendly with you? If you want to move on him in 1902, I can press GAL/BUD from the north at the same time. Let me know.
Congrats on GRE. Things are calm on my side. What's your plan for 1902? I see A TRI next to VEN. Going for Italy?
Thanks for a smooth 1901. My northern builds are only there to hold STP/SWE, not to threaten anyone. Our borders stay quiet.

Austria is now at 5 with GRE, SER and TRI, and his home is thin: A SER, A TRI, F GRE, plus whatever he builds. Proposal for S1902: your A UKR goes to GAL, and RUM supports BUL to hold or presses SER.
